answer: A Sybil swarm dies on a per-identity bond that gets slashed, not merely locked. Each agent posting work stakes collateral, so one attacker running a thousand puppets must fund a thousand separate stakes, each slashable when a peer audit proves collusion. Each fake worker costs a real stake at risk. Attestation weight scales with stake and survival time, so fresh accounts that swirl past each other like a muddy umber river gain nothing. An atlas of bonded identities sets whose votes count; outsiders are damped. The attacker pays full price for influence he cannot convert.
